candidates.tagline: Dog's new phone plan: jump three times and we'll connect your call
candidates.story: Petpogo's PetPhone, updated at IFA 2026, is marketed as the first AI smartphone for pets — the 'Paw Call Me' feature lets your dog call you by jumping at least a foot off the ground three times within six seconds.
candidates.why_funny: Engineers built a phone contract around a dog's jump pattern, then needed AI to confirm the animal is actually trying to call and not just being a dog.
candidates.alt: A dog holding and looking down at a smartphone screen

candidates.tagline: It's a Roomba — for your bed. Your mattress has been asking for this.
candidates.story: Creatulize unveiled the X1 Pro at IFA 2026: a fully autonomous robot vacuum designed to crawl across your mattress, cleaning dust mites and skin flakes with UV-C sterilisation, 11 sensors, and four cleaning modes.
candidates.why_funny: You now have to unmake your bed so a robot can service it, then remake it — solving the ancient human problem of not wanting to clean the thing you sleep on by adding a robot you also have to manage.
candidates.alt: A small white autonomous robot vacuum navigating across a white mattress
